## Intent
Hypothesis: compiler auto-vectorization of the per-particle update combined with a fused scatter can approach the streaming ceiling.

## Cache saturation
All measured N (10000–10000000) exceed the L2 spill at N≈7710; N=10000 and N=100000 are L3-resident (spill at N≈246723), N≥1000000 exceed L3. At q=0.01, cost is flat across L3—24.15 ns/p at N=10000, 23.66 at N=100000—then rises ~14% to 26.96 at N=1000000, the L3→DRAM knee. This knee appears at every death rate (q=0.5: 32.26→35.83). Death rate raises the floor ~8 ns/p without reshaping the curve. No L1d/L2 knee is visible since the smallest N already spills both.

## Bandwidth
Peak is 2.87 GB/s at N=100000, q=0.01—22.6% of the 12.69 GB/s ceiling. The algo is frontend-bound, not bandwidth-bound: at that point the profile shows 66.4% frontend stalls, 33.0% compute, 0.6% backend. Even past L3 where backend rises to 12–14%, frontend stays at ~70%. Death rate degrades bandwidth monotonically (q=0.5 peaks at 2.12 GB/s = 16.7% of ceiling) but the bottleneck remains frontend. No transition to bandwidth-bound occurs at any N or death rate.

## Assembly
The compiler vectorized component-wise within one particle, not across particles. The update loop (0x107f620) processes one particle per iteration at stride 0x44 (68 bytes), using `vmovups`, `vshufps`/`vinsertps`, and `vmulps`/`vaddps` for packed 4-float math—no gather. The fused scatter (0x107f6f0) uses byte-granular framebuffer stores: `movzx`/`add`/`cmp bx,0xff`/`cmovae` then `mov BYTE PTR [r13+r9*1+0x0]`, three byte stores plus alpha per pixel. Eleven `vucomiss` comparisons and scalar saturation per particle explain the 66–70% frontend stalls capping throughput far below ceiling.

## Verdict
Refuted — peak bandwidth is 2.87 GB/s, only 22.6% of the 12.69 GB/s ceiling, with 66.4% frontend stalls at that operating point. The compiler emitted packed SSE (`vmulps`, `vaddps`) but only component-wise within single particles, and the fused scatter's byte-granular stores prevent streaming. Auto-vectorization does not approach the streaming ceiling in any measured regime.
